question: Which of these sentences best describe the ongoing action(s) in the video 1?
choices: Wipe down the countertop using the sponge in the right hand, pushing any excess food into the food bin that is being held in the left hand.
Wipe down the countertop using the sponge in the right hand, holding the food bin at the edge of the countertop to push any food in.
Wipe down the countertop using the sponge in the right hand whilst positioning the food bin against the side of the countertop so that any food gets pushed into the food bin.
Wipe down the countertop with the sponge in the right hand, pushing the food into the food bin that is placed at the edge of the countertop.
Wipe down the countertop using the kitchen roll in the right hand to remove the sugar from it.
correct_answer: Wipe down the countertop using the kitchen roll in the right hand to remove the sugar from it.
